label: Indian-languages female hypnosis sweep (14 Oct 2026)
description: Telugu-focused sweep extended to Tamil, Hindi, Kannada, Bengali, Malayalam, Marathi and other Indian languages, cross-checked against the Mental Block wiki's 2,247-page Hypnotized Female category. Only non-duplicate, sourced titles added.

records.title: Ti Ratr
records.mechanism: Home-invader 'salesman' hypnotises the wife to extract secrets
records.summary: Newly married Rajani's honeymoon is cut short and odd things happen at home. A salesman arrives for a 'demo' while her husband Rajan is away, takes them hostage, and hypnotises Rajani to extract hard truths about her past. She wakes to Rajan telling her it was a dream, until she finds the salesman's ring in the fish tank.

records.title: Silanerangalil
records.mechanism: Psychiatrist's hypnotherapy uncovers a past-life murder
records.summary: A mute, traumatised young woman ('Anjali', Navya Nair) in a mission home is treated with hypnotherapy by psychiatrist Krishnan. Under hypnosis she reveals she is the reincarnation of a woman allegedly killed by her husband in 1965, and that her caretaker Jo is the husband's reincarnation; Jo then seeks the truth of the old murder.
